title.zh: US House tax committee advances crypto tax overhaul in 38–5 vote
title.en: US House tax committee advances crypto tax overhaul in 38–5 vote

current_state.zh: The US House Ways and Means Committee advanced the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act in a bipartisan 38-5 vote, proposing new federal tax rules for stablecoins, staking, mining, crypto lending, wash sales, and transaction fees.
current_state.en: The US House Ways and Means Committee advanced the Digital Asset Tax Certainty Act in a bipartisan 38-5 vote, proposing new federal tax rules for stablecoins, staking, mining, crypto lending, wash sales, and transaction fees.
